figuren.name: Dr. Ada Scherbenglück

auszuege: TOP CENTER: FEMALE-READ exuberant pyramid archaeologist, taller leaning pear silhouette with long curling goo crest, burnt-coral tied headscarf and small dusty sand-colored neckerchief.

figuren.prompt_auszug: TOP CENTER: FEMALE-READ exuberant pyramid archaeologist, taller leaning pear silhouette with long curling goo crest, burnt-coral tied headscarf and small dusty sand-colored neckerchief. Wide delighted red-pupilled eyes, big asymmetrical open tooth grin, subtle lashes. One hand gently brushes a chunky jade scarab artifact in her other palm with a fat worn excavation brush; scarab has oversized rounded wings and gold insets. Beautiful tangible clay object, no hieroglyph text or floating symbols.

Both goo hands struggle to hold a huge unfurled parchment map curling vigorously back around his goo sides; one large rounded brass compass hangs off map edge.
